glossary_decisions_provisional.unit: kiumbe/viumbe: Glob2 units are creatures; avoids kitengo meaning administrative/measurement unit and kikosi meaning military squad. Requires independent approval.

uncertainties.issue: English says steal units; translated kuwavuta (attract/draw them) to match conversion mechanic. Reviewer should determine whether kuiba is required to preserve adversarial intent.
Silaha za kujikinga is understandable protective equipment but may suggest weapons. Check whether Kinga is preferable for combat armour statistic.
Waliopangiwa uses animate agreement for unit roles while creature noun uses vi- agreement. Caller may use nounless label; independently check.
First-personification hu- plus aki- consistently treats named controller as animate; grammar and semantic rendering of waves needs review.
Concatenated fragment caller must be inspected to determine subject/concord and divergence meaning.
Concatenated count suffix may require likes-as-count rather than liked-items interpretation; inspect caller.
Concatenated fragment uses i- agreement. Inspect noun it modifies; rewrite full phrase if necessary.
